API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APIUser ManagementGet Groups
Get Groups
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/groups

Retrieves a list of groups. The search parameters find matching values in the name or comments attributes.

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
search
string

The search string used to match against a group's name or comments attributes

definedBy
string

The string value defined by the group name or other applicable attributes

page
int32

Specifies the page offset

Default value: 1
pageSize
int32

Specifies the page size

Default value: 100
sortBy
string

Possible values: [id, name, expiry, status, externalId, rank, modTime]

Sorts the groups based on available values

Default value: id
sortOrder
string

Possible values: [asc, desc, ruleExecution]

Sorts the order of groups based on available values

Default value: asc
Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
id
int32
REQUIRED

Unique identifier for the group

name
string
REQUIRED

Group name

idpId
int64

Unique identifier for the identity provider (IdP)

comments
string

Additional information about the group

isSystemDefined
boolean

System-defined group

]
